change: On-the-fly augmentation of training slices WITHOUT the elastic term: rotation +-15 deg, scale 0.9-1.1, intensity shift +-0.1, elastic_alpha 0 (E015 had elastic alpha 10). 50 epochs instead of 25. No horizontal flip. One sampled geometric transform is applied identically to all input channels and the GT.
hypothesis: E015 showed augmentation helps heart (0.883, best of all runs) and esophagus (0.640 > E001 0.610) and narrows the train/val gap, but the elastic term collapses the thin trachea (0.081 vs E001 0.377). Dropping elastic should recover trachea while keeping the heart/esophagus gains; 50 epochs gives the augmented model time to converge (25 may be undertrained).
plan_reference: Follow-up to E015_augment (full_plan.md item 1.5); proposed in E015 result discussion
